key_reasoning.reason: Single Tailwind class change on the bottom actions/status row of the shared Card component. Scored S rather than XS because every catalog that renders Card (not only Hosted Applications) picks up the wrap behaviour.

Presentation-only CSS change (flex-wrap, gap and height overrides split between preview and non-preview cards) that follows the existing responsive-wrap pattern. No security, state or data impact, and rollback is trivial. Scored S because the regression surface is visual and spans other card consumers.
Clear bug report: the activate-version action and the status labels overlap, and they must not. The only judgement call was the breakpoint and wrap behaviour.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XS to S: touches a shared UI component (Card) used across multiple catalog pages
